real.evidence: REAL, NOT CUT — this was the trap. gml_Object_obj_tasque_manager_enemy_Step_0.gml:171-175 sets `dc.special = 1; dc.difficulty = 4;` when `global.encounterno == 89`, and :149-150 / :215-216 force rr = 1 and scr_turntimer(99999) under the same condition. cut.name: RisingDiamonds
cut.evidence: gml_Object_obj_tasque_manager_enemy_Other_24.gml:130-135 — Other_24 is user event 14 and NOTHING in Chapter 2 calls event_user(14). cut.name: obj_tm_quizzler_old / obj_tm_whip_animation_old / obj_tm_whip_attack_backup
cut.evidence: Three superseded drafts sitting in the chapter. Grepping every .gml in Chapter 2 for these three names finds references ONLY inside their own event files — no live code creates them. Not dispatcher entries (no monsterattackname); recorded so nobody rediscovers them and assumes they play.

mechanics: TWO shipped encounters, same boss object. (A) ENCOUNTER 57, the story fight (scr_encountersetup.gml:559-573): THREE monsters — obj_tasque_enemy (monstertype 32, 240 HP / AT 8 / sparepoint 20) / obj_tasque_manager_enemy (monstertype 42, 1367 HP / AT 10 / sparepoint 5) / obj_tasque_enemy, stats at scr_monstersetup.gml:778-827 and :1157-1186. Each takes its own turn, so a real bullet phase can run up to three obj_dbulletcontrollers at once. (B) ENCOUNTER 89, the dojo challenge 'Tasque Manager Says' (scr_encountersetup.gml:1005-1019): a SOLO Manager with custom hero positions, unlocked by recruiting her, launched from obj_fusionmenu_Step_0.gml:637-642 with global.ambush = 1, global.flag[35] = 1 (dojo mode: scr_gameover.gml:29-33 turns a death into a flagged loss instead of a real game over) and global.flag[61] = 1 (scr_recruit.gml:3 — no recruiting inside a dojo fight). Red soul only in both — no green/purple/yellow mode, no shrinktangle, no custom box (grep for maxxscale/maxyscale over every tasque/tm file and over the type 2/3/20/32 controller branches returns nothing, so obj_growtangle keeps its default 2x, obj_growtangle_Create_0.gml:13-14). (1) ATTACK SELECTION IS PLAYER-DRIVEN, not random: the Manager whips every turn unless the party ACTed Order that turn (obj_tasque_manager_enemy_Step_0.gml:249 = Kris's acting == 2 'Order'; :273 = acting == 3 'OrderX', the everyone-act with actactor 4 — both named in scr_monstersetup.gml:1170-1179), which sets overrideAttack = 1 and swaps the next turn to the Quiz; overrideAttack is cleared again at :183. Both ACTs are gated on violenceused == 0 (:237, :266) — hit a Tasque and the ACT fails and the Manager whips forever. There is no HP gate, no phaseturn ladder and no random attack roll anywhere in this fight. In the dojo encounter :149-150 hard-forces rr = 1 every turn, so it is nothing but quizzes. Two decoy `rr` writers must not be mistaken for the chooser: Step_0:36 is the enemytalk DIALOGUE roll and Step_0:187 is the battle-MESSAGE roll assigned after the controller already exists (same vestigial shape as Spamton NEO's trailing choose). (2) DIFFICULTY IS A LADDER ON PLAYER SKILL: Step_0:12-23 watches obj_tm_quizzler; when a quiz ends, `if (hitbysimonsaysattackcount < 2 && quizDifficulty < 3) quizDifficulty++`. That counter is incremented by the two things that can hit you mid-quiz — obj_tm_quizzap_Other_15.gml:3-7 (the wrong-quadrant zaps) and obj_tasque_soundwave_Other_15.gml:3-4 (a Tasque's meow landing on top of the quiz). quizDifficulty therefore climbs 0->3 across successive quizzes and is passed straight into the controller (Step_0:178). Its effects in encounter 57 are round pace — attacktimer 90/60/60/40 for difficulty 0/1/2/3 at obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:1291-1294 — and the zap window 20/15/15/20 at obj_tm_quizzler_Step_1.gml:148-153. The difficulty >= 4 branch (Step_1:17-21, `turns = difficulty - 3`, multi-letter rounds) belongs to the DOJO encounter, which starts at 4. The `difficulty == 5` / `difficulty == 4` arms right below it (:22-31) are unreachable in ALL cases, shadowed by the `>= 4` test above them — genuine dead code. (3) THE QUIZ IS A SIMON-SAYS MINIGAME, NOT A BULLET PATTERN: type 32 rotates the battle box to 45 degrees (obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:1275-1276), draws a grey spr_tm_grid diamond plus four spr_tm_letters corner markers at +/-50 px, and spawns obj_tm_quizzler, which picks letters avoiding an immediate repeat via the Manager's lastQuizLetter (Step_1:37-56), flashes them as obj_tm_quizletter pairs (Step_1:113-135) and then fills the three WRONG quadrants with obj_tm_quizzap (Step_1:155-163, `if (i == letters[currentturn]) continue;`). The player must be standing in the announced quadrant. In encounter 57 special stays 0 (obj_dbulletcontroller_Create_0.gml:23), so `made` is set to 1 at :1278 and NEVER increments (the made++ at :1404 is inside `if (special == 1)`), `made == 4` is never true, no scoring happens, and the quiz just loops single-letter rounds via :1401-1416 until the turn ends. (4) THE DOJO VARIANT IS A SCORED, LOSABLE MINIGAME: with special = 1 the controller sets global.turntimer = 5400 (:1244-1245), `made` climbs to 4 (:1404), and the machine at :1300-1399 runs THREE PHASES of four rounds. Passing a phase draws spr_tm_maru + a big spr_tm_maru_big obj_tm_quiz_result and does difficulty++ (:1305-1329). Getting hit sets controller.special = -4 from obj_tm_quizzler_Step_1.gml:3-7 (`global.encounterno == 89 && global.inv > 0`), which routes to :1367-1399 and stamps a spr_tm_batsu, strikes++. strikes == 3 (:1343-1351) sets global.flag[36] = 1 and global.flag[39] = 1 and boots the Manager offscreen — that is a DOJO LOSS, not a game over: flag[39] ends the battle (scr_mnendturn.gml:17; obj_battlecontroller_Create_0.gml:266 and obj_npc_dojo_Step_0.gml:130 clear it) and flag[36] is what makes obj_npc_dojo_Step_0.gml:51 skip the $250 payout. Clearing phase 3 (:1353-1360) sets special = -5 and flag[39] without flag[36] — the win. (5) THE MANAGER COMMANDS THE TASQUES: at rtimer == 2 on a quiz turn with more than one monster alive, Step_0:140-147 does `with (obj_tasque_enemy) rr = (quizDifficulty > 1 && quizDifficulty != 4) ? 2 : -1;`. The Manager's rtimer == 2 lands before the Tasques' own rtimer == 15 dispatch, so this always wins. rr = -1 matches NO dispatcher arm, so the Tasques take a deliberately SILENT turn during an easy quiz; once quizDifficulty > 1 they instead fire MeowWow at difficulty 1 on top of it. The `!= 4` guard is vestigial: quizDifficulty is the boss's own 0..3 field and this whole block is behind scr_monsterpop() > 1, which the solo dojo encounter fails. (6) THE WHIP IS A DRAW-EVENT ATTACK: type 20 creates obj_tm_whip_attack, which hides the Manager and drives obj_tm_whip_animation. obj_tm_whip_attack_Step_0.gml is a 4-state loop (wind up 20 -> strike 35 -> zap 55 -> recover 65, reset to 5) gated on `global.turntimer > 30` so it never starts a swing it cannot finish. The bullet obj_tm_whip's x/y/image_angle, the warning telegraph and the whip 'rope' are all computed in obj_tm_whip_animation's Draw_0 (lines 84-155); the ring of obj_regularbullet zaps is emitted from that object's Step (lines 68-105): 4 bullets at 90 degrees at difficulty 0, 8 at 45 degrees with a per-tick rotation drift at difficulty 1. (7) YARNBALLS IS ALSO A DRAW-EVENT ATTACK: type 2 spawns obj_yarnmaker every 10*ratio frames with a launch angle solved by scr_getlaunchdirection for childgravity 0.5 and a speed remapped from the enemy's height above the camera; every third throw ((made % 3) == 2) is aimed straight at the soul. But obj_yarnmaker has NO Step event — its scale-up AND the `scr_bullet_create(x, y, obj_yarnbullet)` that produces the actual bullet both live in obj_yarnmaker_Draw_0.gml:1-30. (8) PRE-FIGHT MERCY: Step_0:1-10 reads global.flag[419] (set to 1 or 2 by the overworld painting quiz at scr_text.gml:6057/6067) and starts the Manager at mercymod 100 or 50 — the right answer makes her instantly spareable. Sparing the Manager also spares both Tasques (Other_20:1-2), and sparing a Tasque gives the Manager +35 mercy (obj_tasque_enemy_Other_20.gml:6-9); Petting a Tasque is a flat +100 (tasque Step_0:141-142). (9) TURN LENGTH: both enemies call scr_turntimer(140) (manager Step_0:182, tasque Step_0:78) with a 120 floor while winding up; type 32 then does `global.turntimer += 120` (obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:1287), so a story quiz turn is really 260 frames. scr_turntimer only RAISES, so the 120 floor is dominated. In the dojo the same block runs scr_turntimer(99999) at :216 and the controller overwrites it with a flat global.turntimer = 5400 at :1245. (10) BULLET RATE SCALES WITH PARTY SIZE: obj_dbulletcontroller_Create_0.gml:12-18 sets ratio = 2.3 at 3 monsters, 1.6 at 2, 1 at 1 — every type 2 / type 3 timing is multiplied by it, so a solo-boss studio run is ~2.3x faster than the real opening turn. (11) THE TASQUE'S TWO ATTACKS ARE SHARED CONTENT: obj_tasque_enemy is also in encounters 52, 70, 74, 86, 87, 92 and 98 (scr_encountersetup.gml:482, 736, 787, 958, 974, 1062, 1156), where the same `rr = choose(0, 1)` chooser runs with no Manager to override it.
engineNeeds: 1. ROTATED BOX COLLISION. obj_growtangle's parent IS obj_battlesolid and its sprite and mask are both spr_battlebg_0 (Chapter 2 objects.tsv line 879), and the soul is confined by `place_meeting(x + px, y + py, obj_battlesolid)` in obj_heart_Step_0.gml:61-80. The Quiz sets image_angle = 45 (obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:1275-1276, plus obj_growtangle_Step_0.gml:46 which folds target_angle into image_angle every frame while growing), so confinement must honour a ROTATED rectangle mask; an axis-aligned box will let the soul out of the diamond and break the whole quadrant mechanic. obj_tm_quizzap (parent obj_regularbullet, sprite spr_tm_gridzap, image_angle 0/90/-90/180, xscale/yscale 2 — obj_tm_quizzap_Step_0.gml:1-17) needs the same. 2. OBJECT-INDEX-AS-INSTANCE ASSIGNMENT. obj_tm_quizzler_Create_0.gml:23-32 does `if (instance_exists(obj_tm_whip_animation)) animator = 460;` — 460 is the raw asset index of obj_tm_whip_animation (objects.tsv line 462, i.e. asset index = line - 2), not an instance id, and the object then does `animator.creator = ...`, `animator.quizmode = 1`, `animator.state = 2`, `animator.zapping = true`, `animator.quizloop = true`. This is the GML 'assign through an object index, broadcast to all instances' idiom and it is hit on EVERY quiz round after the first, because the first quizzler's Destroy (Destroy_0.gml) does not remove the animator. 3. MISSING OBJECT: obj_tasque_soundwave. type 3 (MeowWow) creates obj_chainbullet with `d.childBullet = 456` (obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:109) and 456 is obj_tasque_soundwave (objects.tsv line 458); obj_chainbullet_Step_0.gml:12 then does `scr_childbullet(x, y, childBullet)` eight times (totalBullets 8, firingSpeed 2). Because the reference is numeric, gen_objects.js's name-based transitive closure (the object-ref regex at gen_objects.js:95 only matches /obj_\w+/) never reaches it: VERIFIED — obj_tasque_soundwave appears in docs/js/gml_object_index.js but is entirely ABSENT from docs/js/gml_objects.js, while obj_yarnmaker, obj_tasque_meowing, obj_chainbullet, obj_tm_whip_animation, obj_tm_quizzler and obj_tm_quizzap are all present. Without it the meow bullets get no growth (Step_0: image_xscale/yscale += 0.025 * (speed / 7)) and no damage hook (Other_15, which is also one of the two writers of hitbysimonsaysattackcount, so the difficulty ladder mis-measures too). Add it as a root, or teach the closure to resolve numeric object indices. 4. DRAW-ORDER-SENSITIVE BULLET GEOMETRY, TWICE. obj_tm_whip's x/y/image_angle and its `warning` telegraph are written from obj_tm_whip_animation's DRAW event (Draw_0.gml:84-155), and obj_yarnmaker's scale-up plus the `scr_bullet_create(x, y, obj_yarnbullet)` that makes the actual yarn bullet are in obj_yarnmaker_Draw_0.gml:1-30. Draw must run every frame, before collision, for BOTH — if the studio ever skips Draw for an invisible or off-screen instance, YarnBalls produces no bullets at all. 5. MULTI-PART MONSTER DRAW. obj_tasque_manager_enemy_Draw_0.gml composes six limb sprites through draw_monster_body_part_ext with per-part sin/cos wobble and a sparesprite[] swap once mercy is maxed, and early-exits while obj_tm_whip_animation is visible (:1-2); obj_tm_whip_animation_Draw_0.gml re-draws the same six with draw_sprite_ext plus a spr_whitepixel rope (12x2, rotated, lerped in 6 segments). All the helper scripts these need — draw_monster_body_part_ext, scr_remapvalue, scr_getlaunchdirection, scr_inverselerp, scr_childbullet, scr_bullet_create, scr_bullet_inherit, scr_dark_marker, scr_dark_marker_animated, scr_monsterattacknamecount, scr_bulletspawner, scr_turntimer, scr_monsterpop — are already present in docs/js/gml_scripts.js (verified by grep). 6. GENERATOR PROVENANCE TRAP — NOW SUBSTANTIVE, NOT COSMETIC. readdirSync returns gml_Object_obj_tasque_manager_enemy_Other_24.gml BEFORE ..._Step_0.gml, so gen_attacks.js's de-duplicator keeps the DEAD Other_24 copies of WhipAttack (type 20) and QuizAttack (type 32) and discards the live Step_0 ones — verified by dry run. Because the dojo quiz is REAL content, this now costs real information: measured on the two copies, the live Step_0 QuizAttack yields extraFields ['element','special'], hasSpecial TRUE and difficultyLiteral 4, while Other_24's yields extraFields [], hasSpecial FALSE and difficultyLiteral null. The emitted entry therefore hides the studio's only handle on the dojo variant. The live rr values survive only as alsoChoices ([0] on the whip, [1] on the quiz) and the emitted `choice` fields are Other_24's (whip 0, quiz 2). An `excludeFiles` hook on the BOSSES entry is the fix; gen_attacks.js has no such field today. 7. SETUP REPLAY GAP FOR MeowWow. attackAnnouncements nulls the MeowWow branch's setup because its `escaped` heuristic sees `if (rr == 2)` inside the body and the nearest preceding condition is `rr == 0` (from the YarnBalls arm above it). Moot in practice: extraAttackFiles entries get setup: null anyway, so BOTH Tasque attacks lose `dc.element = 6` and MeowWow loses `dc.difficulty = 1` — difficulty has to come from the studio's DIFF selector. 8. QUIZ DIFFICULTY IS BOSS STATE, NOT A LITERAL. `dc.difficulty = quizDifficulty` reads the boss's own field (0 from Create_0:32), so the story entry has usesDifficulty = true and difficultyLiteral = null; to see quiz difficulties 1-3 the studio must write obj_tasque_manager_enemy.quizDifficulty (or override dc.difficulty) — replaying the branch verbatim always yields 0. To see the DOJO quiz the studio must set controller special = 1 and difficulty = 4 (and, for the batsu path, global.encounterno = 89, which obj_tm_quizzler_Step_1.gml:3 and obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:1367/1383 all read directly). 9. scr_monsterpop() DEPENDENCE. The whip's difficulty is literally `scr_monsterpop() == 1` and obj_dbulletcontroller's `ratio` is 2.3/1.6/1 by population, so a one-monster studio scene reproduces the END of encounter 57 (whip d1, ratio 1), not its opening (whip d0, ratio 2.3) — but it IS the correct population for the dojo encounter. A faithful story replay needs three monsters registered. 10. UNINITIALISED BOSS STATE. Neither Create event nor scr_enemy_object_init defines `rr` or `rtimer`; both are created implicitly during the enemytalk phase (manager Step_0:114 sets rtimer = 0, :36 first writes rr). Anything that replays the boss Step straight into the bullets phase will read undefined `rtimer` at :129. The box and turn blocks this config slices touch neither, so the default path is safe — this only matters if someone widens the slices. 11. DEAD FIELD, DO NOT CHASE IT. obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:1411 sets `d.turnlength = 90` on every re-spawned quizzler, but obj_tm_quizzler never reads turnlength in any of its five events. Round length is entirely `turnspeed` (30) plus the controller's attacktimer. 12. THE DOJO QUIZ TOUCHES GLOBAL FLAGS. obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:1345-1346 and :1356 write global.flag[36] and global.flag[39]; a studio harness that does not reset them (obj_battlecontroller_Create_0.gml:266 clears flag[39]) will end the very next turn early, because scr_mnendturn.gml:17 reads flag[39].
